audited_prs.title: [ReviewBus] XR-CUTOVER-001 Execute dual-run, reconciliation, cutover and rollback of legacy odayplus external ingestion
audited_prs.author: Claude2
audited_prs.exact_diff_summary: 65 files changed (1,511 additions, 10,027 deletions) attempting whole-module deletion of legacy external ingestion.
audited_prs.superseded_by: PR #991 (ODP-XR-CUTOVER-ACTIVATE-002, commit b32fd65f) merged into origin/dev.
audited_prs.rationale: PR #970 cannot be closed merely because it lacked a board card; it was fully audited in docs/evidence/completion/ODP-XR-CUTOVER-ACTIVATE-002/pr-970-disposition.md across all 65 files. The destructive deletions and renamings were rejected because they broke rollback capabilities and deleted required regression tests. Instead, PR #991 implemented the canonical ODAY_MARKET_DATA_FACADE_MODE=PLATFORM_PRIMARY switch with default-deny on all external sources. All valid objectives of PR #970 landed cleanly via PR #991 without orphaned code.
